lxc_f239bb0b0d0e5458.text: This cafe roleplay starts when you walk in for a drink.

lxc_58ecbc65ca13cdc1.text: You choose a coffee, order politely, and share a friendly comment.

lxc_1b9fea3417de46cb.text: A cafe is a place that serves coffee drinks.

lxc_6dcd8b649bc393ed.text: A coffeehouse is another name for a cafe.

lxc_20ecee81617bc38b.text: The drinks can include espresso, latte, americano, and cappuccino.

lxc_8e2d1d4bb6dd1f28.text: Some cafes also serve light snacks.

lxc_3368a8d5a6a09a9d.text: People use cafes in different ways.

lxc_ad488faa1fc3e760.text: Friends can meet and talk there.

lxc_669e88e1b8930ee8.text: A person can also sit alone and pass the time.

lxc_642c31331957335d.text: You are not only buying a drink.

lxc_dfd05bbdfda9f388.text: You are entering a place where a short, friendly talk can feel natural.

lxc_f4c63a5056d19ce4.text: It is a concentrated form of coffee.

lxc_779af7a1ecd419aa.text: Hot water moves under high pressure through finely ground coffee beans.

lxc_53cdb38747e2f171.text: A typical serving is small, about 25 to 30 ml.

lxc_0d891483c2c2e37a.text: An espresso has a dark body.

lxc_a11166dd88faa039.text: A lighter foam sits on top.

lxc_bcf5c7564fe8da77.text: Espresso is also the base for other drinks.

lxc_e31522911a656418.text: Cappuccino and caffe latte both begin with espresso.

lxc_810743f2d541edc0.text: Knowing this helps you understand the drinks on a cafe menu.

lxc_7f91107e19ce04e2.text: A cappuccino is an espresso-based drink.

lxc_769e64c072458954.text: It has espresso and steamed milk.

lxc_ddfbaad6acf373cc.text: Steamed milk is milk heated with steam for a coffee drink.

lxc_612f837a3c5d8855.text: The top layer is thick foam.

lxc_6d9ca8facf2adc95.text: This gives a cappuccino a clear look and feel.

lxc_44a4f92b64227ec7.text: Today, it usually has one espresso shot, but it can also have a double or triple shot.

lxc_c8553ef5098b2057.text: A cappuccino is typically smaller than a caffe latte.

lxc_eb641e1fba9942ff.text: Think of espresso below, warm milk in the middle, and thick foam above.

lxc_ef1070c2eb8ba0c2.text: A latte, or caffe latte, comes from Italy.

lxc_357d711ee01751af.text: It is made with espresso and steamed milk.

lxc_fdb944ccfc104243.text: A latte does not have the same thick foam layer as a cappuccino.

lxc_f0322ce575315fa0.text: A cappuccino can come in a small 140 ml cup with thick foam.

lxc_4402b78696b5c857.text: A caffe latte can come in a larger 230 ml glass or cup.

lxc_68724b19d0cbaadc.text: Traditionally, it is served in a glass.

lxc_0052f7bf5307c350.text: In English, latte means the coffee drink.

lxc_1b7703e0280aee9e.text: These details can help you choose between the two drinks.

lxc_b38e3553503eae2b.text: The customer names the drink in a short order.

lxc_8f8d582020919de9.text: I would like an espresso, please.

lxc_2603f9108a6610a6.text: Thank you comes after the cafe worker brings the drink.

lxc_706211e691828796.text: The drink name, please, and thanks are enough.

lxc_aece5c2685d72803.text: A cafe is a place to meet and talk.

lxc_6829562e0e0ba95f.text: Small talk is light friendly talk after the order, not the drink name.

lxc_d0539b577e575914.text: The other person may answer with a few words.
